data.text:
Premjith C vs Food Safety Officer Haripad Circle on 23 May,
2024
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas 
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.9892/2023 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Thursday, the 23rd day of May 2024 / 2nd Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2023 In Crl.Mc No. 9892 Of 2023
 St 237/2021 Court Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class -Ii, Haripad, Alappuzha
 Petitioners/Petitioners:
 1. Premjith C, Aged 49 Years, S/O Chandramohan, Chandralayam,
 Nangiarkulangara P.O. Haripad, Alappuzha, Pin - 690513.
 And 2 Others. 
 Respondents/Respondents:
 1. Food Safety Officer Haripad Circle Office Of The Food Safety Officer
 Haripad Town Road Haripad, Pin - 690114. And 2
 Others. 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the
 High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in St.237/2021
 pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magitrate Court-II,
 Haripad, pending disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the
 application and this court's order dated 21/11/2023 in Crl.M.A.No.1/2023
 and upon hearing the arguments of Sri.Premjit Nagendran, Advocate for the
 petitioners, and of Public Prosecutor for the 1st and 2nd respondents,
 M/S.Chithra.P.George S.C for 3rd respondent, the court passed the
 following:
 Order
Interim order shall stand extended by six months. 
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 23-05-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Premjith C vs Food Safety Officer Haripad Circle on 23 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10207836/
